detail: A kept guard's contract serializes optional fields as explicit nulls, and the hand written deserializer read a present-but-null key as a malformed struct, so any guard carrying a query-semantics invariant could not load and silently stopped guarding. The defect lives in one deserializer with no runtime dependency, so a bounded unit test over the exact contract JSON is the stable reproduction authority; it fails on the parent with the verbatim error and passes on the fix. The gate compiles this test from scratch in a worktree, so the dogfood-policy job installs the Rust toolchain and the CLI's linux system libraries; without them the build fails and the gate misreports it as a fixed-side test failure.
